citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
The licensee did not submit an itinerary two days in advance of travel for the event they were inspected at on August 1st,
2026. Failure to provide an itinerary two days in advance of travel for the exhibition of regulated animals under the Animal
Welfare Act makes it difficult for APHIS officials to be able to properly inspect the regulated animals at events the licensee
travels to. The licensee must submit an itinerary two days in advance of any travel for overnight events from here on out.
Correct starting on 8/18/26.

Natural or artificial shelter was not provided for the pigs in their enclosure at the time of inspection. Not providing shelter
for the pigs doesn't allow them to escape the elements of the weather. Natural or artificial shelter appropriate to the local
climatic conditions for the species concerned shall be provided for all animals kept outdoors to afford them protection and
to prevent discomfort to such animals. Correct starting on 8/18/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
End of report.
